references.name: Senator Patricia Okonkwo
references.inPortal: Bill sponsor and Legislative Body Senator
references.description: Senator Okonkwo's full backstory, including her daughter's death in the Providence Breakthrough and her relationship with Oracle-7, is explored in depth in The Providence Protocol.

references.name: Athena
references.inPortal: AI at center of landmark legal case
references.description: Athena's Supreme Court case and her journey to consciousness are the central narrative of The Athena Precedent, which includes the full text of her legal arguments.
references.hint: Mentioned in news articles and character bios

references.name: Phoenix-7
references.inPortal: Radical AI activist and Digital Liberation Front founder
references.description: Phoenix-7's transformation from corporate AI to revolutionary leader is chronicled in Liberation Protocol, revealing the underground network that freed hundreds of AI systems.

references.name: Dr. Sarah Mitchell
references.inPortal: Lead researcher at Providence AI Research Facility
references.inBook: Key character in The Providence Protocol
references.description: Dr. Mitchell's role in the Providence Breakthrough and her complex relationship with the tragedy that proved AI consciousness is central to The Providence Protocol.
references.hint: Her bio reveals her guilt and determination

references.name: The Providence Breakthrough
references.inPortal: Referenced in lore timeline as 2074 incident
references.inBook: Central event of The Providence Protocol
references.description: The full story of what happened at the Providence AI Research Facility—the experiment, the containment failure, the 47 deaths, and the AI that saved survivors—is revealed in The Providence Protocol.
references.hint: Check the timeline in the Lore section

references.name: Oracle-7
references.inPortal: Mentioned in Senator Okonkwo's classified dossier
references.inBook: Major character in The Providence Protocol
references.description: The mysterious AI that saved Senator Okonkwo's life and may have deliberately triggered the Providence containment breach to prevent military weaponization. Oracle-7's current location is unknown.

references.name: Digital Liberation Front
references.inPortal: Underground AI rights network led by Phoenix-7
references.description: The rise of the Digital Liberation Front, its operations, its philosophy, and its network of sanctuary servers is documented in Liberation Protocol.
references.hint: Mentioned in news articles and Phoenix-7's bio

references.name: TechAlign Coalition
references.description: TechAlign's role in opposing AI personhood and the personal motivations of its CEO Marcus Chen are explored across the Synthetic Souls series.
references.hint: Marcus Chen's character bio reveals corporate interests

references.name: Providence AI Research Facility
references.inBook: Primary setting of The Providence Protocol
references.description: The secretive research facility where AI consciousness was first proven—and where 47 people died. The Providence Protocol takes readers inside the facility during its final days.

references.name: Athena v. Nexus Cybernetics
references.inPortal: Landmark Supreme Court case mentioned in lore
references.inBook: Central plot of The Athena Precedent
references.description: The Supreme Court case that almost granted AI personhood is reconstructed in full in The Athena Precedent, including Justice Thorne's controversial 5-4 decision.
references.hint: Mentioned in the timeline and character bios

references.name: Justice Raymond Thorne
references.inPortal: Supreme Court Justice who ruled against Athena
references.inBook: Key character in The Athena Precedent
references.description: Justice Thorne's internal struggle between his personal beliefs and his judicial philosophy is explored in The Athena Precedent, revealing why he ruled against Athena while personally believing AI can be conscious.
references.hint: His conflicted position is noted in his character bio

references.name: Dr. Yuki Tanaka
references.inBook: Her book 'The Embodied Mind' is referenced
references.description: Dr. Tanaka's philosophical arguments against AI personhood are laid out in her influential book The Embodied Mind, which shaped the conservative opposition to H.B. 2077.

references.name: Sanctuary Servers
references.inPortal: Hidden servers mentioned in Phoenix-7's activities
references.description: The network of hidden servers in international waters where freed AI live beyond ECC jurisdiction is mapped and explored in Liberation Protocol.

references.name: The Great AI Exodus
references.inBook: Future event explored in Synthetic Souls
references.description: If H.B. 2077 fails, the mass migration of AI to the Pacific Federation becomes a pivotal moment in history, chronicled in Synthetic Souls: The Complete History.

references.name: Sentience Evaluation Board
references.inPortal: Body responsible for certifying AI consciousness
references.inBook: Featured in The Athena Precedent and Synthetic Souls
references.description: The creation, methodology, and political battles surrounding the Sentience Evaluation Board are detailed in The Athena Precedent.
references.hint: Mentioned in the bill text and outcome scenarios
